claimBoundary: All rows were captured with ComparativeLab --diagnostic. Values are directional same-harness evidence only and are not release-claim evidence.

comparators.name: Fovea
comparators.notes: Zero measured hitch; cancel waste is one 32KiB origin chunk above PINRemoteImage; resident decoded-memory footprint is above Apple, Nuke and SDWebImage.

findings: Fovea is tied for the best hitch endpoint at zero measured hitch excess.
PINRemoteImage has the lowest cancel waste in this diagnostic matrix; Fovea trails by exactly one 32KiB origin chunk total.
Fovea is not the memory leader on W1: Apple, Nuke and SDWebImage have lower physical-footprint deltas.
The current Fovea rendered cache uses a 64MiB total cost budget and W1 cycles through 128 assets at 320x240, creating one-pass scan pollution before the budget fills.
activeExperiments: URLSession delegate queue QoS utility -> default, isolated control-plane A/B; not yet benchmarked.
Rendered cache scan-resistant probation/main split: default 16MiB probation plus remaining main budget; not yet benchmarked.
nextGate: Fresh Release must keep hitch excess at zero, reduce abandoned bytes toward or below 128KiB, and reduce W1 footprint below at least Nuke/SDWebImage without regressing W2 warm-memory or W2 warm-disk.
